item.title: Indy7 Robot JSON, PC-HMI, and Read-only Digital Twin Architecture
item.description:
Project resources

The public implementation and the related education-team report are intentionally separated.

  • GitHub repositorygithub.com/HeungJAELEE/Busan_Robot
  • Related automotive Digital Twin team report/docs/Robot_Digital_Twin.pdf

GitHub is the evidence for the PC-HMI, robot-controller, MQTT, DB, and web-twin implementation. The PDF is a broader team project and is not used as proof of every repository-level result.

Portfolio summary: Problem–Role–Action–Result–Evidence

Item Verified scope
Problem Partial edits to Conty JSON could break Waypoint/program/move references, while multiple HMI, DB, and twin clients connecting directly to the robot would scatter command ownership and state timing.
Role Designed and implemented the public Busan_Robot repository’s JSON compatibility layer, PC-HMI boundary, backend services, and operating documentation.
Action Built round-trip preservation, single IndyDCP socket ownership, separate MQTT command/state topics, a MySQL worker, PLC bridge, WebSocket read-only twin, and Offline/Direct/Gateway execution modes.
Result Published a frontend/backend monorepo with Docker Compose, deployment and communications documents, and a staged validation path. No unsupported latency, uptime, or collision-reduction metric is claimed.
Evidence Public source and README, JSON design, PLC/MES integration, communications, setup, and deployment documents; related team PDF.

Resume bullets

  • Designed a load–edit–save–reload validation flow that preserves Conty/APK JSON Waypoint, program-tree, and move references.
  • Centralized IndyDCP physical sockets in one Robot Controller and separated MQTT command, result, realtime, connection, and error topics.
  • Split a CustomTkinter HMI, MySQL DB worker, PLC bridge, and WebSocket digital twin into independent service boundaries with Docker Compose documentation.
  • Added Offline UI, Direct, and MQTT Gateway modes so JSON and UI behavior can be checked before physical robot connection.

Interview STAR

  • Situation: Reference damage in a robot program file and concurrent socket access can compromise both compatibility and physical-control accountability.
  • Task: Preserve the teach-pendant format while allowing PC editing and let HMI, DB, and twin consumers share one trustworthy robot state.
  • Action: Define JSON round-trip invariants, make Robot Controller the single IndyDCP owner, and route other components through explicit MQTT events.
  • Result: Published a reproducible HMI/backend structure and operator documents. Omniverse remains a future read-only adapter rather than an unverified production claim.

1. What the system does

The system reads Neuromeka Indy7 Conty/APK JSON, displays and edits its hierarchy, supports a virtual play path, writes compatible JSON, and separates physical robot commands from data consumers.
